name: ch.antevo/companies
title: Antevo Companies
description: Swiss company files from Zefix and SHAB: group structure, sanctions lists and a watch for changes.

tools.name: find_company
tools.description: Find a company by name or Swiss UID (CHE-123.456.789); an LEI or ISIN finds the Swiss company that carries it, or a company outside Switzerland that Antevo holds because it owns a Swiss one (a thin file). Returns candidates, each with its `entity_id`, legal form and seat; no file is opened. Pass the chosen candidate's `entity_id` to company_file. `country` is optional. Names find Swiss companies only in this version; a name with another country answers `not_covered`.

tools.name: company_file
tools.description: The public record on ONE company, by the `entity_id` find_company returned (or a Swiss UID): identity, dated register changes, sanctions-list checks and the sections the summary lists. Without `layer` the answer is a summary of at most 6,000 characters; with `layer` (register, history, sanctions, identity, leadership, regulator, or another section the summary lists) one section, paged with `cursor`. `as_of` (YYYY-MM-DD) gives the file as it stood on a date; `since` (YYYY-MM-DD) lists the changes after a date, and by default the summary shows what changed since this account last opened the file. A thin file (an entity_id starting 'lei:', a company with no Swiss UID) has no history: its GLEIF record, its parents and the Swiss companies it owns, and sanctions-list checks.

tools.name: watch_company
tools.description: Watch companies. `action`='start' (the default) starts watching one: at most one alert a day, listing what changed with its sources; `entity_id` is the one find_company returns (or a Swiss UID), and `layers` optionally narrows it to a comma-separated list of register, sanctions, regulator (blank watches all). `action`='list' lists the companies this account watches.

tools.name: stop_watch
tools.description: Stop watching one company, given by its `entity_id` (or a Swiss UID): no further alerts for it. A company watched through a book (a Mandates firm's or a household's companies) goes on alerting, and the answer says so. A stopped watch can be started again.
